scenario_title: DB pool cut on a downsized RDS
title: Latency and timeouts on api-gateway

detection.alert: api-gateway: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-06-10 19:05-23:15: api-gateway: 163 of 267 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-06-10 19:05 and 2026-06-10 23:15 UTC (peak error ratio 0.82 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 27.878 s vs baseline band up to 0.245 s.

_templates.macro: Config change shrank the {svc} database connection pool; requests queued for connections and timed out (the meta-db downsize days earlier left no headroom).
_templates.remediation: Revert {key} to {old} in {file}; right-size aws_db_instance.meta_db before lowering pools again.

culprit.diff:
@@ -51,3 +51,3 @@ db.pool.max_size
 db:
-  pool_max_size: 60
+  pool_max_size: 6
   # managed by the platform team

rca.macro: Config change shrank the cloud-api database connection pool; requests queued for connections and timed out (the meta-db downsize days earlier left no headroom).
rca.remediation: Revert db.pool.max_size to 60 in config/cloud-api.yaml; right-size aws_db_instance.meta_db before lowering pools again.

action_items: Add validation bounds and a canary for risky config keys (pool / timeout / retry / flags).
Alert on the error signature `GET <*> <*> <*> target=cloud-api`.
